(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; A color-5 rectangular frame carries paired markers ON its border: a color sitting at BOTH
  ;; ends of an interior row (its left AND right border cell) fills that row inside the frame;
  ;; likewise a color at both top AND bottom of a column fills that column. Colors paint in
  ;; ASCENDING order (columns then rows within each color), so crossings resolve to the highest
  ;; color deterministically.
  (let* ((b (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 5)))
         (r1 (first b)) (c1 (second b)) (r2 (third b)) (c2 (fourth b))
         (border (append (map (lambda (r) (at g r c1)) (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
                         (map (lambda (r) (at g r c2)) (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
                         (map (lambda (c) (at g r1 c)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                         (map (lambda (c) (at g r2 c)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))))
         (colors (sort (filter (lambda (v) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 5))) (unique border)) <)))
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((color colors))
      (let* ((after-cols
              (for/fold ((acc out)) ((c (range (+ c1 1) c2)))
                (if (and (= (at g r1 c) color) (= (at g r2 c) color))
                    (recolor-cells acc (map (lambda (r) (list r c)) (range (+ r1 1) r2)) color)
                    acc))))
        (for/fold ((acc after-cols)) ((r (range (+ r1 1) r2)))
          (if (and (= (at g r c1) color) (= (at g r c2) color))
              (recolor-cells acc (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range (+ c1 1) c2)) color)
              acc)))))))
